question: The Jaffna Peninsula, known for its cultural heritage and Tamil population, is located in which part of Sri Lanka?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Northern Province**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Jaffna Peninsula** is located in the **Northern Province** of Sri Lanka.
 
• This region is known for its rich **cultural heritage** and a significant population of **Tamils**.
 
• The Jaffna Peninsula has a long history and is an important cultural and economic region.
 
• The capital of the Northern Province is **Jaffna**, which is the main city of the peninsula.
 
• The area is also known for its **historical temples** and **forts**.
 
• The Northern Province has faced significant challenges due to the **civil war** in Sri Lanka, but it remains a crucial part of the country’s cultural fabric.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Eastern Province**__

 __
 
• The Eastern Province of Sri Lanka is known for its **beautiful beaches** and **tourism**.
 
• The capital of the Eastern Province is **Trincomalee**, which has a major port and naval base.
 
• This province is also home to a diverse population including **Tamils, Muslims, and Sinhalese**.
 
 
 
• **Western Province**__
 __
 
• The Western Province is the most **populated region** in Sri Lanka and includes the **capital city, Colombo**.
 
• This province is the commercial hub of the country and has a high level of **urbanization**.
 
 
 
• **Central Province**__
 
 
• The Central Province is known for its **hill country** and the city of **Kandy**, which is famous for the **Temple of the Tooth Relic**.
 
• This region is also a major area for **tea production** in Sri Lanka.
